appointment.question: Do I need an appointment?
appointment.answer: We recommend creating an appointment via WhatsApp or phone before your visit so we can reserve a suitable time. Our Balçova Ege Park AVM branch is open 11:00-22:00 on weekdays and 11:00-21:00 on weekends.

services.question: Which massage options are available?
services.answer: Swedish (classic) massage, Bali massage, deep tissue massage, medical massage, aromatherapy massage, Thai mix massage, and the Sultan massage performed by two therapists are among the options offered at our branch.

duration.question: How long do sessions take?
duration.answer: Duration varies by the service you choose and the treatment plan. We share the exact duration with you while creating your appointment.

hammam.question: Do you offer Turkish hammam?
hammam.answer: Yes. Alongside massage and care options, you can also experience the luxurious and traditional Turkish hammam at our branch.

couples.question: Can we come as a couple?
couples.answer: We offer couples packages so you can share this relaxing experience with your loved ones. Just let us know while booking so we can plan a suitable time.

location.question: How do I get to the branch?
location.answer: Luna Den Spa is located on the 2nd floor inside Ege Park AVM in Balçova. After entering through the main mall entrance, follow the directional signs and take the elevator to the 2nd floor.

firstVisit.question: How should I prepare for my first visit?
firstVisit.answer: No special preparation is needed. Our team shares every detail you need to know for your chosen service before your appointment.

swedish.title: Swedish (Classic) Massage
swedish.description: One of the most commonly preferred massage types, applied with relaxing touches to help loosen the muscles and support blood circulation.

bali.title: Bali Massage
bali.description: Inspired by Far Eastern techniques, this special therapy supports body and mind balance with rhythmic touches and pressure techniques for deep relaxation.

deepTissue.title: Deep Tissue Massage
deepTissue.description: This therapy works on the deeper layers of muscle and connective tissue, helping reduce intense muscle tension and ease chronic discomfort.

medical.title: Medical Massage
medical.description: A targeted and therapeutic massage performed by expert therapists for musculoskeletal discomfort.

aromatherapy.title: Aromatherapy Massage
aromatherapy.description: This holistic therapy is performed with natural and special botanical oils, helping provide mental and physical relaxation while awakening the senses.

thaiMix.title: Thai Mix Massage
thaiMix.description: A dynamic therapy combining Thai and classic massage techniques, bringing flexibility and lightness to the body through stretching and pressure techniques.

sultan.title: Sultan Massage
sultan.description: A special experience where two therapists work in sync, offering deep relaxation, maximum comfort, and a unique luxury spa experience.
